items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] by Brahms. A medley of traditional tunes...

ctx.x: by Brahms. A medley of traditional tunes, "Go Down Moses", "Jesamin" and "Good News", Double Quartet, "Call of the Woods," -- that was the double quartet. Then there was an orchestral piece, "Call of the Woods," I see. Then there was a solo, "Swanee River" by Miss Lottie Gee..
